capabilities: Hide parent segments of nested tags
Shorten tags by matching a pattern
Add CSS classes to tags based on tag, parent, or custom definitions
disambiguation: It does not manage, search, or organize tags; it only changes how tags are visually displayed in preview mode.
extras: README references screenshots (preview, editor, settings) but the description of features is brief.
problem: Obsidian offers limited control over how tags are displayed in preview mode, especially for nested tags.
summary: Tag display customizer that changes how tags render in preview mode, including hiding hash symbols, parents, or pattern-matched portions.
